---
name: Bug report
about: Something isn't working as expected
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

**What did you run?**
e.g. `npm start`, `npm run cli -- collaborate composite "..."`

**What did you expect to happen?**

**What happened instead?**
Paste the error message or unexpected output.

**Environment**
- Demo mode or live providers? (`COGNITIVE_ENABLE_LIVE_PROVIDERS`)
- Node.js version (`node -v`)
- OS

**Does it reproduce in demo mode?**
Demo mode needs no API key — if it reproduces there, that narrows the bug to
the core mesh instead of a provider adapter.
